meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Python 的 cobrapy 库加载、构建和导出代谢模型(SBML、JSON、YAML),并运行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等计算,给出通量、生长值等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求加载或导出 SBML 等格式的代谢模型,或做 FBA、FVA、基因敲除等分析时接管。

say.text: 加载 textbook 模型跑 FBA,告诉我生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值和各反应通量

say.text: 对 e_coli_core 做单基因敲除,找出必需基因
say.note: 返回每个基因敲除后的生长值

say.text: 算一下这个模型的 FVA,并给出最小培养基
say.note: 返回通量范围和培养基成分

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Python cobrapy library to load, build and export metabolic models (SBML, JSON, YAML) and run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling and media analysis, returning fluxes and growth values.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to load, build or export SBML/JSON/YAML metabolic models, or to run FBA, FVA, knockout screens and similar analyses.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA - report the growth rate
say_en.note: Returns objective value and reaction fluxes

say_en.text: Screen single gene knockouts on e_coli_core and list essential genes
Run FVA on this model and give me a minimal medium
say_en.note: Returns flux ranges and medium components
